title: Waveform picture over the cleaned dialogue
caption: The cleaned dialogue from the dialogue-cleanup clip turned into a picture: mgvideo waveform draws the sound twice, in brown and in sand, and the brown version fills in from left to right as the audio plays, like a social audiogram.
prompt: Take the cleaned half of ../videos/f22-dialogue-cleanup.mp4 (the last 6 seconds) and make an audiogram for social: draw its waveform with mgvideo waveform, once in Magnifito brown #7a584c (played) and once in sand #d8c6b4 (still to play), and set it in a white card on the cream background (card.svg, Geist from fonts/). The brown waveform should fill in from left to right in time with the sound.
commands: ffmpeg -loop 1 -framerate 30 -t 6 -i work/card.png -loop 1 -framerate 30 -t 6 -i work/wave-played.png -loop 1 -framerate 30 -t 6 -i work/wave-ahead.png -i work/clean.wav -filter_complex "color=c=0xfbf8f3:s=1600x360:r=30:d=6,format=rgba,split[c1][c2];[c1][1:v]overlay=0:-570,format=gbrp[played];[c2][2:v]overlay=0:-570,format=gbrp[ahead];[played][ahead]blend=all_expr='if(lt(X,W*T/6),A,B)'[wave];[0:v][wave]overlay=160:390,format=yuv420p[v];[3:a]aformat=sample_rates=48000:channel_layouts=stereo[a]" -map [v] -map [a] -t 6 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/audiogram.mp4
credits: Sound: f22-dialogue-cleanup from this showcase (synthetic voice-like tone track generated by make-audio.mjs; no third-party audio, no real speech)
